3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01.@EndUserText.label: 3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01
3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query: SELECT SUBSTRING("CalendarDate", 1, 6) AS "CALMONTH", MIN(TO_DATE("CalendarDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "CALMONTH_START_DATE", MAX(TO_DATE("CalendarDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "CALMONTH_END_DATE", MIN("FiscalYearVariant") AS "FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT", MIN("FiscalYear") AS "FISCAL_YEAR", MIN("FiscalPeriod") AS "FISCAL_PERIOD", MIN("FiscalYearPeriod") AS "FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD", MIN(TO_DATE("FiscalPeriodStartDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE", MAX(TO_DATE("FiscalPeriodEndDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE" FROM "3GV_DIM_FISCALCALENDAR_01" WHERE "FiscalYearVariant" = 'V3' GROUP BY SUBSTRING("CalendarDate", 1, 6) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYearVariant") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYear") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalPeriod") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYearPeriod") = 1
